notes: Hub statuses and product facts are preserved as published; no approval or passing result is inferred.
All date strings preserve source formatting. Dates reported/released are not relabeled as test dates.
Product lot and linked-certificate lot are separate fields. A mismatch must not be silently resolved.
Product-page claims are not measured results. Measured results reside only on their source certificate document.
Absent result values are null or empty. ND and Not Detected are retained as strings, never zero.
Verification URLs transcribed without a protocol in PDFs are supplied with https://; original printed text is retained. No verification portal authentication was attempted.
The 5-Amino-1MQ Open COA link is a product photograph. It is preserved as hub_coa_link_url and excluded from coa_pdf_url.
Only public Biomod product pages and published product COAs were accessed.
